verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Rippling IT sells identity and access management, but nothing in the evidence describes access reviews, certification campaigns, scheduled re-justification, reviewer routing, or sign-off records. The closest items are different capabilities: automatic provisioning on role changes, evidence collection, and AI-built 'audit-ready reports' about devices and compliance gaps, which do not amount to recurring access certification.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
